app.name: Talisman
app.description: Self-custody wallet for managing accounts, assets and connections to supported blockchain applications.

reviewMethod: Agent review of official product documentation and production network configuration; maintainer-authorized publication through tested main
notes: Official published v15 production config maps polkadot, kusama, polkadot-asset-hub, kusama-asset-hub, hydradx, astar, bifrost-polkadot, bifrost-kusama and Ethereum id 1. Disabled-by-default is not interpreted as unsupported; testnets are excluded. Listed networks are the verified subset in this directory, not an exhaustive product support list. No funded transaction or security audit was performed.
